```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

## Regression Model Summary

```{r}
load(params$input)
if (exists("regression_results")) {
  knitr::kable(summary(regression_results)$coefficients)
} else {
  "Regression results not found in the supplied file."
}
```
